title: 第二章  一箭三雕！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

最后一个字落地，全场鸦雀无声。

那些刚才还吵吵嚷嚷要浸猪笼的家丁下人，被这目光一扫，莫名觉得后脊背发凉。

反观林澈蹲在笼子里，眼睛直勾勾盯着高高在上的月璇玑，那眼神里头，三分怒意，三分委屈，还有四分“老子不服”的倔强劲儿。

月璇玑被他这么一瞪，先是愣了一下，随即眉毛一挑，心说：

“嘿，这个废物，居然敢直呼本宫的名讳？”

“还拿镇国公府来压我？”

“这是被吓得失心疯了不成？”

可当她瞧见林澈那双红得吓人的眼睛，感受到他身上那股子说不清道不明的气势时，心里莫名咯噔了一下。

怪事，莫非今儿个太阳打西边出来，废物都生出了父皇的气势？

不对不对，一定是幻觉。

这个跟个木头桩子似的男人，能有什么气势？

怕是被河水泡发了，肿的吧。

就在场面一度尴尬之际。

月璇玑终是开口了：

“把他拖上来。”

声音不大，但全场都听见了。

两个侍卫把林澈连人带笼子拖上岸，可笼子没

林澈蹲在里面，像菜市场上待价而沽的大公鸡，就差脖子上挂个价签了。

月璇玑悠然起身，冷冷俯视着林澈道；

“你要自证清白是吧？”

“行，本公主给你一个自证清白的机会。”

说实话，她也挺好奇的。

这废物到底有什么底气，敢在今天这个局面下硬刚？

别人不知道他在镇国公府中的处境，自己还能不清楚？

若不是太后一旨诏书让月璇玑心生忌惮，今日非要将林澈淹死不可...

林澈却不知月璇玑心中所想，只是长长松了口气，暗暗感谢各路神仙保佑。

他定了定神，清了清嗓子。

“殿下，今日之事，处处透着古怪。”

林澈开口了，声音虽然还有些发颤，但条理清晰得很：

“您想啊，就算我真的跟丫鬟有私情，那肯定也是偷偷摸摸，外人怎会知晓？”

“这不是明摆着有人给我设套吗？”

他顿了顿，眼神像刀子一样扫过旁边站着的那位孙平孙公子。

“我现在要见那个告状的人，当面对质！”

孙平站在那儿，面不改色心不跳。

既然敢设这个局，那自然是把方方面面都安排妥当了。

他嘴角微微一扯，露出一个意味深长的笑容。

“林驸马，你可别怪我多嘴。”

“你在府外跟丫鬟拉拉扯扯，那可是我亲眼所见，你想赖也赖不掉。”

林澈脸上的表情精彩极了，这孙子不是睁眼说瞎话吗？

“哦？”

林澈拖长了调子：

“原来是孙公子您亲眼瞧见的？”

“那我倒要问问，您是在哪儿瞧见的？”

孙平的目光像钉子一样钉在林澈脸上，一字一顿地说：

“我看到你和丫鬟在逛庙会。”

“逛完庙会后，你二位在马车里头……”

“那马车摇晃的弧度可是不小！”

“这种事本公子可不会看错！”

“更不会听错....”

孙平故意顿了顿，嘴角的弧度更大了：

“说句不好听的，驸马爷，您这也太不要脸了吧？”

这话一出口，周围那些个家丁仆人立马就跟打了鸡血似的，一个个跳出来落井下石。

“哎呀呀，驸马爷真是好雅兴啊！”

“大白天在马车里就行那鱼水之欢，果真是不要脸到了极点！”

Page (1/3)

As the last word fell, the whole place fell into silence.

Those servants who had just clamored to soak the pig cage felt an inexplicable chill running down their spines when they were glanced at by this gaze.

On the other hand, Lin Che was squatting in the cage, staring directly at Yue Xuanji, who was above her. In her eyes, there was three parts anger, three parts grievance, and four parts stubbornness that said, "I don't want to accept it."

When Yue Xuanji was stared at by him, she was stunned for a moment, then raised her eyebrows and said in her heart:

"Hey, this loser actually dares to call me by my first name?"

"Are you using the Zhenguo Palace to suppress me?"

"Are you so frightened that you went crazy?"

But when she saw Lin Che's frighteningly red eyes and felt the indescribable aura on his body, her heart skipped a beat for no reason.

Strange thing, could it be that the sun rises in the west today and the trash has the aura of his father?

No, no, it must be an illusion.

How powerful can this man who looks like a wooden pile be?

I'm afraid it was soaked in the river water and swollen.

Just when the scene was awkward for a while.

Yue Xuanji finally spoke:

"Drag him up."

It wasn't loud, but the whole audience heard it.

Two guards dragged Lin Che ashore with her cage, but there was no cage.

Lin Che squatted inside, like a big rooster waiting for price in a vegetable market, all she needed was a price tag hanging around her neck.

Yue Xuanji stood up leisurely, looked down at Lin Che coldly and said;

"You want to prove your innocence, right?"

"Okay, this princess will give you a chance to prove your innocence."

To be honest, she was quite curious.

What confidence does this loser have that he dares to be tough in today's situation?

If others don't know about his situation in Zhenguo's mansion, how can he not know it himself?

If it weren't for the Queen Mother's edict that made Yue Xuanji feel fearful, Lin Che would have been drowned today...

Lin Che didn't know what Yue Xuanji was thinking. She just breathed a long sigh of relief and secretly thanked the gods for their blessings.

He collected himself and cleared his throat.

"Your Highness, what happened today is full of weirdness."

Lin Che spoke, and although her voice was still a little trembling, it was very clear and coherent:

"Think about it, even if I really have an affair with the maid, it must be secretive. How would outsiders know about it?"

"Isn't it obvious that someone set a trap for me?"

He paused, and his eyes swept across Mr. Sun Pingsun standing next to him like a knife.

"I want to see the person who complained now and confront him face to face!"

Sun Ping stood there, his face unchanged and his heart not beating.

Since you dare to set up this situation, you must have arranged all aspects properly.

The corners of his mouth twitched slightly, revealing a meaningful smile.

"Consort Lin, don't blame me for talking too much."

"You were flirting with the maid outside the house. I saw it with my own eyes. You can't ignore it even if you want to."

The expression on Lin Che's face was extremely wonderful. Isn't this grandson telling lies with his eyes open?

"Oh?"

Lin Che drawled:

"So it was Mr. Sun who saw it with your own eyes?"

"Then I have to ask, where did you see it?"

Sun Ping's eyes were like nails on Lin Che's face, and he said word by word:

"I saw you and your maid visiting the temple fair."

"After visiting the temple fair, you two were in the carriage..."

"The carriage is shaking quite a bit!"

"Young master, I will never be wrong about this kind of thing!"

"You can't hear me wrong..."

Sun Ping paused deliberately, and the curvature of the corners of his mouth became wider:

"To put it bluntly, Prince Consort, are you too shameless?"

As soon as these words were spoken, the servants around him immediately jumped out one by one to add insult to injury.

"Oh my, my consort is so elegant!"

"It's so shameless to have sex in a carriage in broad daylight!"
